By spitting in our face and presenting five counter-conditions, demanding an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. source_text:
Look at what we are dealing with here. Amid escalating Middle East tensions, our government—rather than projecting American strength and standing firmly with our greatest ally—went behind the scenes and proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan. What an absolute embarrassment to our national sovereignty and our traditional foreign policy. 

And how does the rogue regime in Tehran respond to this weakness? By spitting in our face and presenting five counter-conditions, demanding an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. This is what happens when you try to appease hostile actors instead of backing law, order, and traditional military deterrence. 

Thankfully, Israel shows some backbone in this mess. Israel remains sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict. While our institutions pursue weak-kneed diplomacy that compromises our values and emboldens our enemies, at least someone in the region understands that national survival requires personal responsibility, strength, and refusing to bow to radicals.

And how did the rogue regime in Tehran respond to this weakness? This is the inevitable result when feckless leaders try to appease hostile actors instead of backing law, order, and traditional military deterrence.
